name: agent-bus-plugins
description: Coordinate work across multiple AI agent sessions on the same machine via a local message bus. Bundles the agent-bus MCP server, the universal coordinator skill, and an optional Stop hook for listener resilience.

plugins.name: agent-bus
plugins.description: Local message bus for agent-to-agent communication. Register a name, delegate to helpers, get a second opinion, ask specialists by capability, broadcast to channels, and track shared tasks — all through one SQLite file. Requires the @agent-bus-connect/cli npm package to be installed.
